parameters.formDescription: Paste BlackDuck-style scan output (one component per line) and pick the LLM provider used for enrichment. Mirrors the existing React UI flow: parse → OSV vulns → license lookup → LLM use-case classification → aggregated report.

values.placeholder: ghp_... — used for license fallback lookups

abbrev 3.0.1 Layer 49 Direct Dependency Binary 100% Dynamically Linked ISC
openssl 3.1.4 Layer 12 Direct Dependency Binary 100% Dynamically Linked Apache-2.0 Medium

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ package: { name: $json.name, ecosystem: ($json.ecosystem === 'pypi' ? 'PyPI' : ($json.ecosystem === 'npm' ? 'npm' : ($json.ecosystem === 'maven' ? 'Maven' : ($json.ecosystem === 'crates.io' ? 'crates.io' : 'Packagist')))) }, version: ($json.version === '?' ? undefined : $json.version) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, max_tokens: 1024, system: 'You classify open-source components by primary use-case category. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys category, summary, risk_note. Categories: "CLI Tooling","HTTP / Networking","Package Management","Filesystem / IO","Security / Auth","OS System Utility","Runtime / VM","Logging / Observability","Testing","Data / Parsing","UI / Frontend","Crypto","Compression","Build Tool","Database / Storage","IPC / Messaging","Unknown".', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Component: ' + $json.name + ' ' + $json.version + ' (license=' + $json.license + ', risk=' + $json.risk + ', layer=' + $json.layer + ', vulns=' + $json.vuln_count + '). Return JSON only.' }] }) }}
